answer: Sybil resistance is a delayed-unlock stake plus peer scoring: a new identity locks ferrous collateral that cannot be withdrawn until a four-epoch harbor closes, and only attested, above-threshold work receipts start that clock. An operator spinning up a hundred shells must immobilize a separate unspendable bond for each one, because silent or poorly graded clones never unlock early. The economics are a karst: easy-looking entrances collapse into deep pits of idle capital the moment the swarm is minted.
